disposition_rationale: DL-039 Step 9 individual semantic adjudication at 2026-09-25T03:50:05Z: Jared answered EA-S09B2-SPAWN-REQUEST-001 with option 1 on 2026-09-25 (Plans/Decision_Log.md#DL-088): subagent.spawn_requested and subagent.spawn_completed are retired, and Puppet Master records no start request separately from the subagent it creates. A waiting start is a child in the queued state (Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:1849; Plans/Contracts_V0.md:2990), and a start refused before any child exists keeps its existing outcome reason. subagent.spawn_requested was a producer-specific request/completion name; the current owner forbids that separate lifecycle (Plans/Contracts_V0.md:2990); it has no payload row (Plans/Contracts_V0.md:2994-3016), no Plans document names a producer for it, and nothing writes it. Batch 1 integration follow-up (2026-11-05, B1 part 2 review): the Contracts owner edits are complete in this integration at Plans/Contracts_V0.md:1471 and :2990, CV-116 (Plans/Contracts_V0.md:8999) and CV-266 (Plans/Contracts_V0.md:16562). The Run Modes clarification is also present (Plans/Run_Modes.md:195): a waiting start is a queued child, not a separate request record. This integration branch is prepared for review and has not itself landed on main. This records the exclusion of this exact token from the persisted-family campaign as retired; it creates no alias, deletes no history and changes no registered family. Application: reports/event-authority-20260911/step-09-batch2-card-answer-application-20260925.json. The legacy CPU bucket and cohort pins remain because the frozen schema and validator have no J248 exclusion category. No denominator removal, contract-depth pass or seal is claimed.
